{{Quote|[...] boredom hangs in the air as thick as the smoke from a Hutt's joonga pipe.|[[Cohden K'Reye]]|<ref name="Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref>}}
The '''joonga pipe''' was a [[Hookah pipe/Legends|hookah]] [[Pipe/Legends|pipe]] used by members of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. It produced thick smoke.
